sources.verifiedBy: fetched directly from trabajo.pr.gov on 2026-11-05 and read (in Spanish): the Servicio Contributivo page (the employer portal: quarterly planillas, the $7,000 unemployment and $9,000 SINOT limits, ACH payments, employer account creation); the SINOT Reglamento Núm. 1 (https://www.trabajo.pr.gov/docs/Libreria_Laboral/SINOT/Reglamento%20SINOT%20Num1.pdf), whose section on the payment period says the contribution is payable quarterly on or before the last day of the month following the close of the calendar quarter; and Ley 74-1956 (https://www.trabajo.pr.gov/docs/Division%20de%20Apelaciones/Ley%2074-1956,%20Ley%20de%20Seguridad%20de%20Empleo%20de%20Puerto%20Rico%20Revisada%20enero%202025.pdf), whose rate provisions are stated on the first $7,000 of each employee's wages. INFERENCE TO CONFIRM: the quarterly due date is read from the SINOT (disability) regulation; the portal page says the unemployment, disability and special contribution are computed on one quarterly planilla, but the unemployment Act text read does not itself print the date.

returns.name: Planilla trimestral (quarterly payroll declaration and contribution, Portal de Servicios a Patronos 'Remote Tax')
contents: Every quarter employers submit a declaration of the wages paid to each employee (Social Security number, name, amount paid in the quarter) and the number of employees in the last three months; the portal computes the unemployment, disability (SINOT) and special contribution from the current rates.
Taxable wages are limited to $7,000 per calendar year for unemployment and $9,000 for SINOT (portal page; the Act states the unemployment rates on the first $7,000).
Payable on or before the last day of the month after the quarter (read from the SINOT regulation; see the source); the Secretary may extend deadlines by memorandum, which is an input.
Payment online by ACH check through the portal; reports are filed through the Portal de Servicios a Patronos (employer account creation online, confirmed by e-mail).

notModelled: Puerto Rico income tax withholding (Departamento de Hacienda) is NOT modelled: no document was read, and the paycheck engine has no Puerto Rico tax data, so no wages or withholding flow into this layer for Puerto Rico.
The unemployment contribution due date itself is not printed in the unemployment Act text read; it is taken from the SINOT regulation for the combined planilla (to confirm).
Extensions of deadlines by Secretary's memorandum (an input).
The SINOT contribution (disability) is a separate program on the same planilla and is not totalled here.
The engine has no 2026 data file for Puerto Rico, so the wage base ($7,000) is not cross-checked against the engine.
